`final class Lwjgl3ExtGlFrameBufferBinding`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglframebufferbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.lwjgl3.binding` · **Module:** `backend-lwjgl3` · **Source:** [Lwjgl3ExtGlFrameBufferBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/lwjgl3/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/lwjgl3/binding/Lwjgl3ExtGlFrameBufferBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The LWJGL 3 framebuffer binding that calls the functions of `GL_EXT_framebuffer_object`.

## Description

[`Lwjgl3GlBinding.getFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/lwjgl3/lwjgl3glbinding/#Lwjgl3GlBinding-method-getFrameBufferBinding) returns it for the `EXT` family.

## Learn more

- [LWJGL 3 backend](/build/backends/lwjgl3/#the-opengl-binding-is-replaceable)
